dropped.item: Keeping the crew steady when tickets stack up
Caring about details, e.g. whether the salt is right on the third plate of the night
Nights that actually end and a schedule you can plan a life around (only 'you get days off' remains, and 'real' days off is weakened)
Running the kitchen when it counts (only partly covered by running the line in the chef's absence)

Commitment that the sous chef will have a real say in how things are done

'Send us a note' (the restaurant) became 'send me a note' (an unnamed individual), so the actor changed

added.item: Responsibilities 'include but are not limited to ... etc', which implies additional unspecified duties
Characterization of the role as 'a great full time job'
